card.p: Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines built with LangChain and LlamaIndex, designed for clinical documents, research papers, and patient records while ensuring end-to-end HIPAA compliance through encrypted embeddings and access controls.

Multi-step agents using explicit state graphs and conditional edges for clinical workflows such as differential diagnosis, treatment planning, and medication checks, with built-in audit trails for HIPAA accountability.

Systems that connect the LLM to electronic health records (EHR), lab systems, and provider APIs, enabling secure execution of actions like retrieving patient histories or scheduling follow-ups, all within HIPAA-compliant boundaries.

Chatbots that maintain clinical context across multiple encounters, storing summaries of prior visits, allergies, and medication lists while fully encrypting PHI and supporting patient consent management.
Review of existing LangChain implementations for PHI exposure risks, data handling gaps, and encryption practices, plus migration support to meet HIPAA Privacy and Security Rule requirements.
